info.title: PayLink Tenant automation API
info.description: For scripts that run one merchant's console: approve or reject UPI payments, upload bank statements, manage methods, webhooks and risk rules. Authenticate with a developer key (tdk_…) as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; each route needs the capability shown on it. Choose test or live data with `?livemode=true|false` (default false). Everything a tenant admin can do in the console has a route here. A platform key with the TenantOperations capability can call any route for a tenant with `PayLink-Tenant: {slug}` (every capability).

get.summary: What the console's overview shows: the last 7 days, what is waiting, and how far set-up has got.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **payments.read** capability.

post.summary: Creates a payment (as "New payment" in the console does) and returns its checkout_url to share. Amounts in paise.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **payments.write** capability.

get.summary: Payments, newest first, with the console's filters. Dates are UTC days (yyyy-MM-dd); amounts in paise. Answers total and total_amount for the filter.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **payments.read** capability.

post.summary: Releases a payment a risk rule put on hold, so the payer can pay.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **payments.write** capability.

get.summary: The payments list as CSV (up to 50,000 rows), with the same filters as GET /payments.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **payments.read** capability.

get.summary: The payer's UPI screenshot for an attempt. Every view is audited.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **upi.verify** capability.

get.summary: Payment links, newest first; q searches title and code, state is on or off.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **links** capability.

post.summary: Creates a payment link. Amounts in paise; leave amount out to let the payer choose.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **links** capability.

get.summary: One payment link.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **links** capability.

patch.summary: Turns a link on or off. A link that's off tells payers it's no longer taking payments.
patch.description: Needs a developer key with the **links** capability.

get.summary: The link's QR code as SVG, for printing.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **links** capability.

get.summary: The Reports page as JSON: funnel, methods, failure reasons and daily volume. A range is at most 366 days.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **reports** capability.

post.summary:
Imports a gateway's settlement report (CSV, multipart field "report" or a text/csv body). Without a mapping PayLink uses the
columns it recognises (the same guess the console shows); pass column numbers (0-based) to override.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **reconciliation** capability.

get.summary: Imported reports, lines that need a look, the daily close and paid gateway payments not yet settled.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **reconciliation** capability.

get.summary: Disputes reported by gateways.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **disputes** capability.

post.summary: Saves your note on a dispute (what evidence you sent).
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **disputes** capability.

get.summary: The checkout order and amount ranges of the methods that are on, which are resting after errors, and failover.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **methods** capability.

put.summary: Sets the checkout order and amount ranges of methods that are on, and whether failed starts move to the next gateway.
put.description: Needs a developer key with the **methods** capability.

get.summary: Gateways the platform helps tenants get an account with, and this tenant's requests.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **methods** capability.

post.summary: "Get an account": records the request. For a partner-link programme the response carries the link to open.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **methods** capability.

post.summary: Sends a webhook.test event to an endpoint.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **webhooks** capability.

get.summary: Alert kinds, this tenant's alerts and recently sent ones.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **alerts** capability.

post.summary: Adds an alert: kind, threshold, window in minutes, channel (both, webhook or email).
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **alerts** capability.

delete.description: Needs a developer key with the **alerts** capability.

get.summary: Who may sign in, the members with their roles, and the role map.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **team** capability.

put.summary: Who may sign in to the console: approve_only, auto_tenant_admins, role or anyone.
put.description: Needs a developer key with the **team** capability.

post.summary:
Approves a person with a role, changes their role, or removes them. Keys can't make owners or remove the last owner;
owners are made by an owner in the console.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **team** capability.

put.summary: Maps a LoginLink role to a PayLink role (used by the "role" admission mode). An empty paylink_role removes the mapping.
put.description: Needs a developer key with the **team** capability.

get.summary: The tenant's own domain, its DNS records and verification state.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **domain** capability.

put.summary: Adds a domain. Add the TXT record returned, point the domain at PayLink, then verify.
put.description: Needs a developer key with the **domain** capability.

delete.summary: Removes the domain; the platform's address is used again.
delete.description: Needs a developer key with the **domain** capability.

post.summary: Checks the TXT record. Answers 422 while it isn't found.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **domain** capability.

get.summary: The CrudApi connection, the platform's CrudApi address, and the reporting API path.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **data_access** capability.

delete.summary: Unregisters the database from CrudApi and removes the read-only user PayLink made.
delete.description: Needs a developer key with the **data_access** capability.

put.summary: Step 1: a read-only database user (PayLink creates one when it can; otherwise send yours, which is checked to be SELECT-only).
put.description: Needs a developer key with the **data_access** capability.

post.summary: Step 2: registers the database in a CrudApi workspace and creates a Reader client. Its secret is returned once.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **data_access** capability.

get.summary: The tenant's keys (secrets never returned).
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **keys** capability.

post.summary:
Creates a secret key (kind "secret", for /api/v1) or a developer key (kind "developer", for /api/tenant). A developer key
can only be given capabilities the calling key has. The key is returned once.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **keys** capability.

delete.summary: Revokes a key. Calls with it answer 401 from then on.
delete.description: Needs a developer key with the **keys** capability.

get.summary: The API request log: the last calls made with this tenant's keys (no bodies).
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **keys** capability.

get.summary: The tenant's audit log, newest first. verify=true also checks the hash chain.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **audit** capability.

get.summary: A payment with its attempts, refunds and full journey (every event, with who did it).
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **payments.read** capability.

post.summary: Cancels an open payment.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **payments.write** capability.

post.summary: A refund through the gateway, or (manual = true, reason required) a refund the merchant made outside PayLink.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **refunds** capability.

get.summary: PayLink UPI payments waiting for a decision: the UTR the payer entered, and whether there's a screenshot.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **upi.verify** capability.

post.summary: Approves a UPI payment: the money arrived. The note is kept on the journey.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **upi.verify** capability.

post.summary: Rejects a UPI payment: no such credit. The note is kept on the journey.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **upi.verify** capability.

get.summary: UPI payments already approved or rejected (newest first): who decided, when, and the note.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **upi.verify** capability.

post.summary:
Matches a bank statement (CSV) against UPI payments waiting for a check: credits whose UTR and amount match are approved.
Send the file as multipart/form-data (field "statement") or as the raw body with Content-Type text/csv.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **upi.verify** capability.

get.summary: Every payment method with its fields and this tenant's Test and Live settings (secrets never returned).
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **methods** capability.

put.summary: Saves a method's settings for test or live and, with enabled true, checks them and turns it on. A failed check answers 422.
put.description: Needs a developer key with the **methods** capability.

get.summary: Webhook endpoints.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **webhooks** capability.

post.summary: Adds a webhook endpoint. The signing secret (whsec_) is returned once.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **webhooks** capability.

delete.description: Needs a developer key with the **webhooks** capability.

get.summary: Recent webhook deliveries, optionally for one payment.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **webhooks** capability.

post.summary: Sends a delivery again.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **webhooks** capability.

get.summary: Risk rules.
get.description: Needs a developer key with the **risk** capability.

post.summary: Adds a risk rule: kind, value, action (block or review) and a note.
post.description: Needs a developer key with the **risk** capability.

delete.description: Needs a developer key with the **risk** capability.

bearer.description: sk_ key for the Payments API, tdk_ key for the tenant API, pdk_ key for the platform API.
